contents: Only the public headers and source files needed to compile pluto-bridge.exe and its layout tests. These are the corresponding sources for the statically linked BWAPI code in the bridge.
localChanges: include/BWAPI/Client/GameImpl.h includes BWAPI/Game.h before deriving GameImpl from Game
include/BWAPI/Client/PlayerImpl.h includes BWAPI/Player.h before deriving PlayerImpl from Player
include/BWAPI/Client/UnitImpl.h includes BWAPI/Unit.h before deriving UnitImpl from Unit
